entries.title: Numbers 10:5
segments: Blow an alarm; this was done by blowing long and loud with a broken, interrupted sound.

entries.title: Numbers 10:8
segments: Christian ministers are placed as watchmen, and should give the people counsel and warning from God.  When they speak, it should be with such plainness as to be understood, and with such affection as is best suited to persuade the people to follow their directions.

entries.title: Numbers 10:10
segments: May be to you for a memorial before your God; may, as it were, remind him of his engagements to you as his covenant people.  Compare

entries.title: Numbers 10:12
segments: Puran; between Sinai and Palestine, west and southwest of Edom, there were two intervening encampments.

entries.title: Numbers 10:13
segments: All men are on a journey through this world.  Jehovah offers to be their guide, and if they follow him he will direct them to the Canaan of eternal rest.  If they reject him, and continue to walk in their own way, they will wander in darkness and find no rest for ever.

entries.title: Numbers 10:14
segments: The standard of the camp of--Judah; that of the first grand division of three tribes.

entries.title: Numbers 10:17
segments: Set forward, bearing the tabernacle; the Gershonites and Merarites followed immediately after the first division, that they might have time to set up the tabernacle before the Kohathites came.

entries.title: Numbers 10:21
segments: Bearing the sanctuary; that is, the most holy things, as the ark, the altar of incense, the candlestick, etc.  See

. 
 
  The other; the Gershonites and Merarites.

entries.title: Numbers 10:29
segments: Raguel; supposed to be the same as Reuel and Jethro.

Those who have chosen God for their guide, and are on their way to heaven, should urge others, especially their relatives and friends, to accompany them, and present as a motive the good which God has promised to those who follow him.

entries.title: Numbers 10:31
segments: Be to us instead of eyes; Hobab was acquainted with the country, and could assist on their journey.

entries.title: Numbers 10:32
segments: Those who are journeying towards heaven need help not only from God, but also from one another; and they may be of great assistance to each other in guarding from danger, and guiding in the way of safety, usefulness, and peace.

entries.title: Numbers 10:33
segments: Three days' journey; namely, from Sinai to the wilderness of Paran.

entries.title: Numbers 10:36
segments: However much assistance the people of God may receive from men, their desires can never be fully met, nor their wants satisfied, without the permanent presence and favor of God.
